name: specs-and-tests
title: Fill the frontend specs and seed the test suite
description: Turn the empty .trellis/spec/frontend templates into real conventions: directory-structure, type-safety, state-management and quality-guidelines, each rule pointing at real code in the repository. Add a vitest suite with at least 12 cases covering the pure helpers (Ackermann steering, box and cylinder inertia, triangle filtering, the physics stepper, direction labels, unit conversion), extracting them from car.js into a testable module first. Acceptance: npm run test is green with 12+ cases and no spec file still reads as an unfilled template.
creator: HelongZhou
